name: Ring of the Paladin
description: (Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:water)An enchanted ring of a legendary paladin infused with his prayers that holds 3 charges and recovers 1 charge every hour. Spend a charge to cast a Rare tier Heal, grant one Uncommon tier blessing like strength or agility, or bless an object with holy energy to create holy water or a temporarily blessed weapon effective against the unholy.
